english: The goblin jolts to the side.
Bastard. Won't catch you off guard this time!
The goblin gives you a nod, and readies his weapon.
One of the stalagmites has sprouted a particularly nasty-looking maw.
Meek's warning saved you from getting grabbed in the last second!
It was hidden well. But your eyes perceive the STRINGS.
The goblin attempts to spring into action, but he's just too late.
Flung around the shadows of the cavern, comes a long tendril.
It flies towards you, like a ballista firing a long, fleshy snake.
In an instant it's wrapped around...
It tightens its grip and flails you around.
But then the tentacle pulls back, dragging you. Flinging you against rock and rock.
The roper has you, its tendril fastened like a locked jaw around your entire leg.
As it attempts to pull you towards its maw.
You're a fish. On the hook. Time to be eaten...
Dragging you in, like a fisherman with a thick catch on his hook.
NOW'S NOT THE TIME FOR A <shake>SIMILE</shake>!
Once you get control of your muscles again, that is.
Oh, wait. A bit too late for that.
It appears you have been ambushed.
That thing... it was perfectly hidden.
Is there really nothing I can do here?
Would've been better to avoid it altogether, honestly.
You cannot... you are too weak.
Waste of time. Try screaming instead.
But you will break its stomach once consumed.
Your companion rushes into action, taking out his sling. "Try to grab something!"
He takes a swing and fires off a bullet in its direction, striking right at its center of mass.
But the bullet just bounces off, and it lets out a horrendous hiss.
But it clearly finds you difficult with all this struggling, so...
It slams you into the ground.
If you don't have anything good to say, say NOTHING. OKAY?!
No. No, way. You're not getting anywhere near that maw.
Slither! Slither like your life depended on it!
You're doomed. Your leg is broken...
There is still a chance. Find an opportunity...
This is not so bad. You've been through worse.
Oh gods. OH gods. OH GODS.
You're a man, aren't you? Get it together.
This is a truly horrible situation.
With a deep, animalistic groan, you push yourself to the limit.
Your body, in a fight against this rubbery appendix of despair...
You get a hold of it, as it slithers around your leg. And you RIP IT TO SHREDS.
The beast shrieks as its tentacle is left broken by your incredible display of power.
A groan escapes your lips as the tentacle tightens around you.
But alas. You do not succeed.
Each loosens the grip of the beast.
Following the violent flinging, you kick and flail and rotate and dance... like a beautiful dance imitating a fish on land.
With a final violent limb-toss, the tentacle actually loosens quite a bit.
Attempting to throw yourself around, to make the tentacle drop you is difficult.
Mainly because it's tossing you around the cavern floor, left to right.
And its grip is tight. Real tight. Too tight!
It's difficult to throw up the somatic signals, but...
The grease immediately appears, covering you from head to toe with the slippery gooey mess.
The roper's tentacle loses its grip.
It wails and flails the appendix around as you're dropped to the ground.
You are a true genius. Now conquer this overgrown squid.
Plus, you can barely see him with this flailing going on.
You grab the tentacle wrapped around your leg, and pump a wave of necrotic energy into its rubbery skin.
You attempt to hit the tentacle with a hand of necrotic energy.
But as you do, the roper just flails you harder, making it impossible to hit.
The goblin rushes up to you and yells.
He struggles against the tendril, in a frantic attempt to save you.
The goblin's bravery is admirable. Make use of it!
The roper keeps dragging you closer and closer to its chomping maw. You glance towards it, seeing the thousands of razor-like teeth almost extending towards you.
You can handle one bite, right?
The roper bites down on your legs.
An intense pain causes your senses to SHUT. DOWN.
You have one chance. Break loose now, or get swallowed.
The latter is probably the case...
The goblin keeps trying to free you.
You're lucky. This is the last chance.
Luck? Nope, you're just fast enough to get a final, final chance.
Now get out of this death grip!
Okay, actually last chance this time. Break. Free!
Here we go, the goblin mutters as he brings out his sling in one swift motion.
He fires off a shot, hitting the beast right at its center of mass.
But it just bounces off. The roper shrieks, clearly angered.
Flung around the cavern comes a long, rubbery tendril.
But it will leave a bruise.
But it is okay. For you are a tank.
It's time to defeat this beast. For real.
This beast will smash you to pieces...
It will be worth the investment.
Am I just in a fist-fight with a monster?
You're a distraction. If you hold out long enough, the goblin will eventually destroy the roper.
You notice its tendril slashing along the ground.
If you were to... stomp on it, then it could surely weaken it.
Then again, you'll probably have to go through here at some point...
But this will be very, very dangerous.
And you hit... right on the roper's rock-hard hide.
You hear a crack, coming from your fist.
It does not take a genius to figure it out.
Simply look at the thing for a few seconds.
This esoteric beast holds but one great disadvantage with this horrific guise.
That... makes a lot of sense.
You look at the creature, trying to figure out...
This esoteric creature will surely be weak to all kinds of magic. But...
Your thoughts are interrupted by the screeching maw of the beast.
At just the right time, you stomp down your boot on the lashing tendril.
You feel the hard-but-soft tissue squish under your weight.
The roper screeches, its maw widening.
Die! And return it to hell...
(Nod to yourself.) "Die, monster! You don't belong in this world!"
You try to hit the timing right, and strike your boot down on the tendril.
But it slithers away, just in time!
As you turn to leave, you feel yourself stumbling.
The roper's tentacle is slashing at your legs...!
Your companion, who's already halfway gone, turns and comes back to you.
You fill your hand with necrotic energy, and...
Your hand crackles with necrotic energy...
But as you attempt to hit the beast, the dark magic does not penetrate its hide.
Wait. The only way to hit this thing properly...
I'll hit him! I swear to the gods...
The goblin lines up a shot, and...
It hits the roper, right next to its large eye.
But it just seems to bounce off.
Even still, the creature does get distracted by the shot.
The roper lashes out again, striking at your legs.
It hits, causing you to fall down on your knees in pain.
I don't think this is working out.
Keep your spirit up. You've still got a chance here...
Depends on how well you can hit it.
Come on, Snell... he whispers to himself and lines up a shot.
With a snap, he launches the bullet.
It hits the beast... right in the eye.
Yes! Take that, you piece of shit!
It roars, and is bleeding from its central eye.
But it's still standing. Now just angered.
Just one more shot! Keep it distracted!
The beast lunges forward, way farther than you expected.
Its maw brushes up against you, and...
It misses! You manage to dodge around its attack.
It goes right through your chainmail.
Keep at it. There is still time.
You're doomed. Let the goblin do the heroics.
Dance around it and yell. Then get ready to dodge...
You jump and stay quick on your feet. And...
(Scream at the roper and wave your arms.)
As you do, the creature clearly focuses on you, even more than before.
But you're ready for any attack.
As you try to move around the creature, you unfortunately stumble over your own legs.
Falling face first onto the ground.
Oh, come on! Don't get eaten, you bastard!
The horrible creature stumbles forward, its maw widening.
And it chomps on your flesh.
The roper does not seem to react to your shrill voice.
The roper extends a deeper part of its maw.
(Fight until you get chewed into bits.)
In perfect form, your fist makes contact with the beast's horrible unblinking eye.
The softness of it molds around you, and a flood of warm disgusting yellow-ish blood begins to flow out of the hole.
Snell gives you a nod as he twirls one last bullet with his sling.
With a loud snap, he fires it.
The echo dances around the cavern, ringing in your ears, along with the horrific screeching of the roper.
As the bullet hits it straight in the large, unblinking eye.
As you turn to run, the tentacles snap around your feet.
Literally. The goblin is already halfway out the cavern.
You move - dodging each and every one of the Roper's attacks.
Oh boy. Let's rethink this one.
The terrible noise disappears into the abyss.
Tentacles writhing, the Roper blindly flees. In its panic, it runs right over the edge.
You fill your lungs with air.
The goblin leans on his knees and groans.
The goblin reluctantly returns a thumbs up to you as well.
He is pained by making such a cheesy gesture.
But you've clearly earned it. Nice.
E-"Let's see what's deeper in this cavern."
